ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate the surface area (~92%), with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips and small specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black pigmentation across the primary ventral surface; high-contrast white clusters (barnacles) mapped to the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel depth of approximately 18% of the visible lobe chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3px to 12px; notable macro-indentation on the trailing margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit an overall concave trajectory defined by irregular, jagged boundaries; leading edges follow a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity white pixels corresponding to barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of light-gray, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge degradation and dense barnacle encrustation at the distal tips.
